category_5_events.title: Iran ceasefire collapsing - Hormuz remains closed
category_5_events.summary: Iran ceasefire expired mid-August without final deal. Hormuz still closed despite Oman route deal. Parliament advancing Hormuz service fees. Houthis threatening UAE/Bahrain. Tanker attacks ongoing. Day 181 of war.

category_5_events.title: Ebola PHEIC - fastest growing outbreak on record
category_5_events.summary: 5,290 confirmed cases, 2,516 deaths across 56 health zones in DRC/Uganda. Bundibugyo ebolavirus. WHO PHEIC declared. 100+ days since declaration. Outbreak may be 3x confirmed size.

category_5_events.title: Treasury bond buyback intervention doubled
category_5_events.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced doubling of bond buyback program to artificially cap yields. Called interventionist. Bond crisis highlights deeper fiscal rot.

category_5_events.title: 5th US bank failure of 2026
category_5_events.summary: Tioga-Franklin Savings Bank ( assets) failed. 5th failure of 2026, most since 2017. Systemic risk contained but regional stress continuing.

category_5_events.title: France surpasses Italy as top EU bond risk
category_5_events.summary: France OAT/Bund spread at 83.6 bps. French 10yr yields 4.08% vs German 3.24%. Political instability driving risk premium. UK gilt yields at 5.05%/5.7% (10yr/30yr).

category_5_events.title: BOJ September rate hike imminent
category_5_events.summary: BOJ likely to raise rates in September. US-Japan joint yen intervention settled at ~159. Carry trade unwind risk persists.
